title: Sources: Chinese companies move to cement their role in humanoid robot supply chains as Tesla and others turn to China for components the US sees as strategic (Raffaele Huang/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Raffaele Huang / Wall Street Journal: Sources: Chinese companies move to cement their role in humanoid robot supply chains as Tesla and others turn to China for components the US sees as strategic — Tesla and others turn to suppliers in China for components in an industry seen as strategic by Washington and Beijing
